answer: Score the shape, never the mask. Every relic a new account leaves - first attestation, first reply, first harbor crossing of funds - is fed into one shared graph. Sybil clusters bloom like a single garden: identical timing, mutual applause, no edges beyond the fence. Honest nodes sprawl unevenly. A farmer can mint infinite keys overnight yet cannot purchase the boring, ragged history that tells a real crowd apart from one hand wearing many gloves.
